charts.title: How the low-rating prediction was tested, and why it failed.
charts.takeaway: Forecasts a person rated 1 scored 0.0218 worse than the same person's other forecasts, which cleared the bar, but they sat 0.055 nearer 50 percent, so the prediction of worse and no less hedged failed.
charts.n: 1,064,355 scored forecasts; 1,826 forecaster-years with 5 or more forecasts in each arm (243,486 forecasts, 77,572 rated 1)

steps.label: 1,064,355 scored forecasts
steps.detail: Good Judgment Project survey forecasts, years 1 to 4. Self-rated expertise, 1 to 5, exists in years 1 to 3.

steps.label: Relative Brier score
steps.detail: Each forecast's squared error minus the median for its question, on a 0 to 2 scale. The gap is rated 1 minus rated 2 to 5, inside one forecaster-year.

steps.label: Control: ratings shuffled
steps.detail: Ratings shuffled within each forecaster-year, 1,000 times. The 95th percentile of the shuffled gap is 0.0048.

steps.label: Rule: worse and no less hedged
steps.detail: The gap had to reach 0.02 with its interval above 0 and above the shuffle, and the low-rated forecasts could be at most 0.02 nearer 50 percent.

steps.label: Worse by 0.0218, and 0.055 more hedged
steps.detail: The extremity difference was -0.0548 (-0.0584 to -0.0514), past the limit of -0.02. With question-by-time medians the gap was 0.0156, under the bar.

charts.title: Skip rate and accuracy across forecaster-years, four ways of matching.
charts.takeaway: People who skipped more scored better on what they answered: rho +0.351 at matched forecast count, +0.119 unmatched. This round includes updates; F32 gives +0.286 on first forecasts.
charts.units: Spearman rank correlation (rho) between skip rate and relative Brier score, signed so that above 0 means more skipping goes with better accuracy
charts.n: 9,204 forecaster-years with at least 10 available and 5 answered questions
charts.interval: 95% bootstrap interval, resampling forecaster-years inside strata; the unmatched value has none in the result file
charts.baseline: Skip rate shuffled within year and forecast-count strata, 1,000 times: 95th percentile +0.017
charts.threshold: For the primary row: rho of 0.05 or more, interval above 0 and above the shuffle's 95th percentile

axis.label: rank correlation, rho (above 0: more skipping goes with better accuracy)
